title: A Regulatory Placebo? The Systemic Failure of Mandatory GenAI Labeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.16470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We examine the worldwide trend of mandatory labeling of generative artificial intelligence(GenAI) as a reactive, symbolic form of legislation triggered by technological panic and institutional responses. From a technical perspective, this study demonstrates that current mandatory labeling not only creates implementation dilemmas but also risks hindering the evolutionary trajectory of AI technology. We then systematically analyze the three dominant theoretical strands of this regime, the value dilution theory, the information authenticity theory, and the proactive regulation theory, and find that they are products of regulators' cognitive limitations in understanding the logic of modern technology. Not only do such formalistic compliance requirements become a regulatory placebo, but they also obscure the genuine legal demands of the technological era. This challenges the current governance paradigm and suggests a shift from identity-lab

translated_title: 监管安慰剂？强制性生成式人工智能标签的系统性失败
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16470v1 公告类型：交叉摘要：我们研究了全球范围内对生成式人工智能（GenAI）强制标签化的趋势，将其视为由技术恐慌和制度反应驱动的被动、象征性立法形式。从技术角度看，本研究证明当前强制标签不仅造成实施困境，还可能阻碍人工智能技术的演进轨迹。随后，我们系统分析了该制度的三大主导理论流派——价值稀释理论、信息真实性理论和主动监管理论，发现它们是监管者理解现代技术逻辑时认知局限的产物。这种形式化合规要求不仅成为监管安慰剂，还掩盖了技术时代的真正法律需求。这挑战了当前治理范式，并建议从身份标签转向更实质性的方法。
tldr: 本文揭示强制GenAI标签作为象征性监管措施存在技术实施困境和理论缺陷，实为“监管安慰剂”，呼吁从身份标签转向实质性治理。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that mandatory GenAI labeling, as symbolic regulation, suffers from technical implementation dilemmas and theoretical flaws, acting as a "regulatory placebo," and calls for a shift from identity labels to substantive governance.
